, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the generation, concluding that the 6th Duke (Charles Louis Bretagne de La Trémoïlle) was the paternal grandfather. The sources shown (including Wikipedia) indicate the 8th Duke (father of Charles Bretagne Marie) was the son of the 7th Duke (Charles Armand René de La Trémoïlle), making the 7th Duke the correct paternal grandfather.
